observations.content: Assistant did log archaeology across all Aug 28-30 pi session files under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-coder-workspaces-learn--/ searching for the two-way channel design discussion.

The phrase 'Urgency over continuity' only appeared in channel test session files 08-12, 10-19, 10-59; assistant concluded the design vocabulary never appeared in any user conversation, only in code comments.

Session 08-12-16 was a channel test asking a subagent to use message_main; 01-57 and 02-20 were smoke-rpc test sessions (web_search/web_fetch test and /snip command flow test, not the design session).

In the 00:06-08:40 main test session, user (in Vietnamese) discussed updating some passed tests, said web-debug extension was deleted and to remove it, and that web_fetch/websearch issues would be handled later.

Assistant concluded the subagent-types channel was designed from scratch in the port session with no upstream reference; the 'design agreed with the user' comment refers to that user, not an upstream design.

Cloned 6 author repos to /tmp/ext-audit-2; the learn repo held the origins: learn/extensions/ has ask-user-question.ts, md-log.ts, quiz.ts, visual-tools/; learn/agents/ has mermaid-maker.md, svg-maker.md, researcher.md; learn/skills/ has visualize.

Confirmed workspace learn-researcher.md is verbatim copy of learn/agents/researcher.md (renamed to avoid collision with pi-subagents' researcher), with model remapped to cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3-flash, thinking set to high, same safe_bash/system-prompt append/auto-exit true.

Assistant mapped subagent-types as fusion of pi-subagents (spawn base), learn repo pieces (mermaid-maker, svg-maker, learn-researcher roles, visual-tools, visualize skill, quiz, md-log), plus new channel code with no upstream.

Assistant recommended not porting interactive-subagents wholesale because its tmux-pane core is TUI-centric and children would not be Paseo agents; instead port its semantics (ask_question parking, name registry resume-by-name, turn-boundary pickup) onto existing Paseo infra, matching user's principle of porting for Paseo not preserving original design.

Assistant corrected its earlier audit: pi has no built-in web_fetch (grep of pi package zero), so no name collision; only one web_fetch (the extension) exists, with functional overlap against harness fetch_content, and recommended keeping both with distinct roles.
User corrected the assistant: harness fetch_content is not native to pi, stating one is a self-devised extension and one installed via marketplace, likely the websearch package.
User agreed (Nhất trí) with porting semantics onto existing Paseo infra and asked why choose only one of the 3 events to send, suggesting sending all 3 turn events is fine.

Settings at ~/.pi/agent/settings.json list installed packages: npm:pi-mcp-adapter@2.11.0, npm:pi-mcp-adapter, and npm:pi-web-access; assistant inferred web_search/fetch_content/web tools come from the pi-web-access package.
Assistant responded that all 3 events (turn_end, before_agent_start, agent_settled) should be used, each covering a distinct gap, with atomic splice and in-flight guard preventing duplicates.
